rules: Exactly one of payload or wire is present per bytes object. Use separate observations with distinct event IDs for separate boundaries; retain the same logical operation correlation.
No bytes object means size unknown, not zero. Bytes are non-negative safe integers in this profile; larger counters require a versioned encoding.
Extensions use a registered namespaced name and a declared meaning. Passing the syntactic namespace pattern is not registration.
Transport sent means only the named local boundary observed a send; remote receipt, admission, application and retention are separate.
A single common stage name is never sufficient evidence; each adapter publishes its exact measurement/receipt semantics.
Sequence is monotonic per node instance, boot and producer. It is not a global order.
OpenTelemetry is an optional export mapping; a node pins its actual semantic-convention version when used.
